name: gizza-ai/scientific-calculator
summary: Evaluate scientific, complex, and worksheet-style math expressions.

tool.description: Evaluate scientific calculator expressions with functions, constants, variables, complex numbers, angle modes, and text or JSON output.

angle_unit.description: Angle unit for trigonometric functions and inverse-trig results.

complex_form.description: Display complex results as a + bi or magnitude-angle form.

expression.description: Expression or worksheet to evaluate. Use one expression per line or separate statements with semicolons; assignments like 'x = 2pi' and 'ans' are supported.

group_digits.description: Add thousands separators to formatted real numbers.

notation.description: How real and complex components are formatted.

output_format.description: Return plain text for humans or JSON with numeric real/imaginary fields.

precision.description: Significant digits to display. Values above 15 preserve interface compatibility but calculations use double precision.

variables.description: Optional variable assignments evaluated before the expression, one per line, such as 'r = 5' or 'theta = pi/4'.
